checks.name: env.load_seed loads the delivered seed with its dataset bundle: ready, with the record count of dataset.json and the coverage report
The snapshot holds the delivered seed byte for byte, at the clock of clock.json
jobs.list in month windows returns every job of the seed once, as the coverage report counts them
The jobs of each month match the job column of the monthly coverage table
The distinct submission days that the Agent reads match the coverage report
usage.summary reads the current period Q4 2026 with its allocation
protocols.list, tables.list and configs.list return every version, table version and config of the seed
The protocol versions read in all six states
A frozen table reads its manifest and its CSV rows
results.list reads the results of the last quarter (218)
notifications.list returns the released notifications that the coverage report counts
results.compare reads two results of the dataset
A seed as of 2026-06-01T00:00:00-04:00 loads with that virtual_now
Every job that the Agent reads was submitted before the as-of time (994 jobs)
The months after the as-of time have no jobs
The current period of the as-of seed is the quarter that contains the time
No read returns a result that ended after the as-of time
